Leo.identity: A large quadrupedal needle-felt lion with a pale honey-cream body and natural tawny/golden-brown mane and tail tuft, apricot inner ears, and amber eyes. Maintain four-paw support and a grounded lion silhouette.
Leo.portrait_identity: Leo's canonical amber eyes, nose, pale honey-cream muzzle, tawny mane outline and rounded ears; preserve the full mane.

anatomy_rules.paws: rounded golden-cream felt toes; no invented nails

Leo.performance_status: minimum pilot views need derivation/review; no atlas imported as authority

canonical.scope: identity only; excludes new poses, scale anchors, scenes and video

Milo.identity: A small handmade needle-felt mouse matching the owner-approved r03 master: warm neutral-grey finely matted wool with soft handmade irregularities, a rounded forehead and softly continuous cheeks, cream muzzle with a small charcoal nose and closed gentle mouth crease, large moss-green irises with dark pupils and modest visible eye white, fine whiskers, two large rounded ears with dark grey felt interiors, a compact torso with a modest elongated cream chest/belly inset, short sturdy limbs and a muted burnt-orange felt tail. Preserve the master's head/body proportions, soft muzzle shape and wool texture. Keep both ears visible where the registered crop permits. No mane, crest, top-hair tuft, protruding pot belly or elongated/slim body. Milo never shows visible teeth, including smiles, speech or gnawing; use soft felt lips against the knot. Scene illumination may tint the lit side while intrinsic wool colours remain consistent.
Milo.portrait_identity: Milo's canonical rounded felt forehead, cheeks, moss-green eyes, two large rounded ears and soft closed mouth crease; no visible teeth.
Milo.performance_status: minimum pilot views need derivation/review; no atlas imported as authority

measurements.Leo: neutral quadrupedal mane-top to supporting paw
